title: Zero disbursement fee
clause: No fee is charged when funds are sent to your account during the promotional period.

title: Higher interest rate
clause: Interest rate is set at 3.5% per month to offset the zero upfront fee structure.

title: Automatic repayment
clause: Repayment is automatically debited from the linked account on the due date.

title: Missed payment penalty
clause: A flat fee of 50,000 UZS applies for each missed payment, plus daily interest.

title: Maximum loan amount
clause: Loans are capped at 20 million UZS for borrowers without collateral.

title: Credit bureau reporting
clause: Payment history is reported to credit bureaus monthly to help build your credit score.
sourceHint: Credit bureau reporting monthly score building
